content.comment_body: I would like to know how to download an older version of [product_name] (specifically version [version_no]) from the web?

Hello [user_name], Please try to ask your question in English, as this is an international forum and using English helps more people reply to your topic. Here is your post translated (using google translate): Kind regards, [user_name]
That's not possible. Only the upgrade to [product_name] [version_no] is downloadable. Installing this upgrade requires an existing version already installed, or an installation disc.

Hello [user_name], The latest version of [product_name] supports previous hardware versions. You can select your old hardware within the software. If you have already purchased the software before, you can update for free. Otherwise, purchasing the software is required.

analysis.insight_summary: Users attempting to download older versions of [product_name] (such as [version_no]) encounter issues because only upgrades for current versions are available online, and these require a pre-existing installation. Direct access to older installation files is limited. Replies mention that recent software releases maintain backward compatibility with legacy hardware, but initial purchase or prior installation is still necessary.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to download and use an older release of [product_name] directly from the official site in order to maintain legacy hardware.
